understanding.goal_understanding: The objective was to clear each level by moving all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked '+' so that every goal is occupied simultaneously, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controlled the currently selected piece (identified by player.id/position) on a grid where coordinates are in pixels and each cell is 3 pixels. MOVE_* actions attempted to shift the selected piece one cell; if a pushable block was adjacent in that direction it could be pushed along, while walls/boundaries could prevent movement (and the movement_blocked flags were only hints, not guarantees). Levels could include multiple selectables, and CLICK with a target_position in the same coordinate system switched control to another selectable at that exact position.

understanding.goal_understanding: The objective was to clear each level by moving all selectable pieces onto the goal tiles marked '+' so that every goal is occupied simultaneously, progressing through all levels until the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controlled the currently selected piece (identified by player.id/position) on a grid where coordinates are in pixels and each cell is 3 pixels. MOVE_* actions attempted to shift the selected piece one cell; if a pushable block was adjacent in that direction it could be pushed along, while walls/boundaries could prevent movement (and the movement_blocked flags were only hints, not guarantees). Levels could include multiple selectables, and CLICK with a target_position in the same coordinate system switched control to another selectable at that exact position.
